description: This script checks network connectivity, manages captive portal and RF captive portal states, restarts network services, and updates device onboarding status based on network responses and system configurations.

methods.name: checkForWanFailOver
methods.description: Checks if WAN failover is enabled by comparing current and default WAN interfaces and querying system parameters.

methods.name: checkForRFCP
methods.description: Determines if RF captive portal should be shown based on system and network status, including RF signal and WAN failover.

methods.name: rfCpInterface
methods.description: Manages RF captive portal redirection, including starting/stopping related services and updating system flags.

methods.name: restartLanServices
methods.description: Restarts LAN-related services such as DHCP, zebra, and v6 services, and updates DNS configuration.
